issues.title: Low contrast metadata text
issues.description: Helper labels adjacent to the minimap do not meet adequate contrast standards against the light background.
issues.evidence: The 'viewport 56×40%' and 'drag to navigate' labels appear in low-contrast light gray.
issues.suggestion: Increase text darkness token to meet minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
issues.triageNote: MiniMap.tsx renders no text at all (only the glass panel + ContentBlock/ViewportFrame divs); the flagged 'viewport 56×40%' / 'drag to navigate' labels are page-level chrome emitted by src/app/eval/pair-074/page.tsx (lines 157–167) with text-neutral-400 (2.12:1 on light bg) — an eval-page file outside the component's editable scope.
